items.title: Farsi test tomorrow. I'm scared S**tless
items.text:
Farsi test tomorrow. I'm scared S**tless
I took up farsi as an optional subject in B.A because people told me it'll be easy to get marks. I took up B.A just cuz i needed a recognized Bacholars degree to add with my associate degree so i could apply for further education in Canada.
Every other subjects is like a piece of cake cuz i grew up in an english speaking home as well as an english medium educational institutes my whole life.
I've been trying to study farsi a month now and so far i just end up either sad or angry cuz it's hard af to write urdu but more hard to understand what a word in farsi means in urdu as well as hoe to pronounce it. 
I got the whole farsi kit too including past papers, guess papers and the book. But like i get overwhelmed by just trying to understand because being bad in urdu on paper and in real life is really making me regret the whole farsi option i picked up.
Is there any chance anyone could tell me a short way to remember and understand some farsi words enough to know what they mean and help me able to translate it into urdu?
(P.s my urdu writing is worse than "inseacts crawling on paper")

Edit: Excuse my spelling mistakes. I'm only human who's doing 2 different languages at once. 

Edit 2: thank you everyone who gave me hope. Turns out i did better than i thought cuz i studied enough to know a little persian.

IELTS is gonna be after this farsi.
And i would appreciate you helping on the farsi part more right now kind sir

I just realized i wrote insects wrong. My bad I'm under a lot of presure trying to learn farsi right now
My aunt who's a masters in urdu told me no one knows farsi at this age and i just gotta write a pretty story to get by
